title: Appointment of New Attorney-General in Accordance with Article 35 of Constitution
what_it_is: Appointment of New Attorney-General in Accordance with Article 35 of Constitution

sections.label: Attorney-General appointment under Constitution
sections.summary: The new Attorney-General's appointment follows Article 35 of the Constitution.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The appointment of the new Attorney-General (AG) is in accordance with Article 35 of the Constitution.

sections.label: No age issue under Article 35(4)
sections.summary: Article 35(4) does not create an age issue for the appointee.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: No, Article 35(4) does not create an age issue for the appointee.

sections.label: Two types of appointments
sections.summary: Article 35(4) provides for two types of appointments, covering two situations.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: If you look at Article 35(4) carefully, it provides for two types of appointments; appointments in two situations.

sections.label: Appointment for specified term
sections.summary: The second situation is an appointment for a specified term, which can end when the term ends.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: The second situation is when the appointment of an AG is for a specified term, say, two years, three years and so on.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: That person can be below 60, can be above 60 and the appointment ends when the term ends.

sections.label: Age not relevant criterion
sections.summary: Age does not seem to be the relevant criterion, and Mr Tan Boon Teik held office past 63.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: And in which case, then the age does not seem to be the relevant criterion.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: And if you look at past practice, the late Mr Tan Boon Teik held the office until past the age of 63.

sections.label: Justice Chao Hick Tin appointment
sections.summary: Justice Chao Hick Tin was above 60 when first appointed Attorney-General.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Current Judge of Appeal, Justice Chao Hick Tin, was above the age of 60 when he was first appointed AG.

sections.label: Constitutional appointments and AG confirmation
sections.summary: The appointments followed the Constitution, and the interpretation given was confirmed with the AG's Chambers.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: All these appointments were in accordance with the Constitution.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: And the interpretation I have put forward, Mdm Speaker, is something we have confirmed with the AG's Chambers.
